desc:
This is the Xbox One / Series dashboard inside ROBLOX 👀! Browse Roblox experiences through your home screen, library, and Microsoft Store.

PC 🖥: Arrows/WASD to move, Enter/Space to select, Backspace/B to go back, Tab/G for the guide, H for Home, L for your library, P for Settings, F2 for party invites.
Console 🎮: A selects, B goes back, View opens the guide. Hold View for invites; LB/RB switch tabs.
Mobile 📱: Tap to select and use the onscreen controls.

UPDATE LOG 🔨
27 October 2026:
• Xbox startup, first-time setup, and the classic Roblox console app.
• Featured, Trending, Up-and-Coming, and Recently Played games.
• Friends, server messages, parties, and invite popups.
• Achievements, gamerscore, themes, and menu animations.
• FortBuild and Five Nights at Fazbears!

More updates are on the way!
